newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - IDEXX estimate, rating cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - IDEXX estimate, rating cut.

text.p: - Vector Securities said it lowered 1997 and 1998 earnings estimates for IDEXX Laboratories Inc , and downgraded to neutral from a buy its rating on the stock, based on an uncertain outlook for the veterinary business.

- Vector Securities analyst Peter Drake said he cut his earnings estimate for 1997 to $0.50 a share from $1.15 and his 1998 estimate to $0.80 from $1.60. He reduced his estimates for 1997 revenues to $306 million from $358 million and for 1998 to $378 million from $452 million.
- Earlier today, IDEXX said it would report 1997 first quarter earnings of $0.02 to $0.05 and revenues of $60 million-$65 million, which is below analysts estimate of $0.21.

- The primary reason for the earnings shortfall was inventory build-up for consumable products in veterinary business. This inventory build-up was unexpected and is the result of market saturation and poor financial controls by management, Drake said in a research note.
- Vector believes the core veterinary business is approaching saturation and this shift led to the lowered expectations for revenues and earnings, the report said.
- Shares of IDEXX fell 20 to 12 in active trading.
